name: Macrocell Grid Traversal
definition: A hierarchical acceleration structure where a coarse grid (macrocell grid) is built over a fine grid to skip empty regions. Each macrocell corresponds to an M × M × M block of original grid cells and stores a boolean flag indicating if any cell in the block is occupied.
summary: Macrocell Grid Traversal accelerates ray traversal by using a coarse boolean grid to skip empty fine grid blocks, offering trivial build times and simple logic.
